info.title: API.SH: Apartment List
info.description: The Apartment List API from API.SH: public Apartment List data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One Apartment List property: name, type, address with neighborhood and coordinates, rents by bedroom count, year built and remodeled, unit count, management company, description and highlights, office contact (phone, email, website, office hours) for managed properties, lease terms, fees (deposit, application, move-in), specials, utilities, parking, storage, pet policy (allowed pets, deposits, rents, limits), renter requirements (income, credit and criminal checks, evictions, smoking), unit and community amenities, every floor plan with each available unit (rent, size, availability date, lease length, apply link), virtual tours, rating, nearby places by category (grocery, restaurants, transit, airports, parks, entertainment, pets, schools with ratings), all photos and disclaimers. Homes let by private people come with the contact name the page shows, without the owner's email or phone. Pass `latest=true` with search params to open the newest matching listing.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apartmentlist-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: An apartmentlist.com property link, e.g. apartmentlist.com/tx/austin/polaris-on-the-park.

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first current result of a search made with the other params given here (the same as the search route's, e.g. location), instead of `url`.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: With `latest`: the search's `location`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Rent statistics for a place on Apartment List: average rents for studios and one to three bedrooms with the trend and pricing date, average and median listed rent and size, a rent histogram (units and properties per price step) and the share of listings with each amenity, optionally for given bedroom counts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apartmentlist-rent-stats

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A city, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or state ("Austin, TX", "78741"), or a place link such as apartmentlist.com/tx/austin. Or give `location_id`.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: A place id from /apartmentlist/v1/suggest, instead of `location`.

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: Comma-separated bedroom counts: studio (or 0), 1, 2, 3.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
US apartments and homes for rent on Apartment List for a place, with bedrooms, bathrooms, price, move-in date, amenities, affordable/senior/student/military/co-living housing and sort. Each listing has id, link, name, address, neighborhood, coordinates, rent range, rents by bedroom count (and the rents matching the filters), bedroom range, units available, soonest move-in, rent special flag, rating, tour booking, summary, unit and community amenities, photos, floor plans (beds, baths, size, rent, available units) and the leasing phone for managed properties. `total` is exact up to 500 matches, otherwise `total_at_least` is given. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apartmentlist-search

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: A city, ZIP code, neighborhood, county or state ("Austin, TX", "78741"), or a place link such as apartmentlist.com/tx/austin. Or give `location_id`.

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: A place id from /apartmentlist/v1/suggest, instead of `location`.

parameters.name: beds
parameters.description: Comma-separated bedroom counts: studio (or 0), 1, 2, 3 (3 = 3 or more).

parameters.name: baths
parameters.description: Comma-separated bathroom counts: 1, 2, 3 (3 = 3 or more).

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Minimum monthly rent (USD).

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Maximum monthly rent (USD).

parameters.name: move_in_date
parameters.description: Move-in date (YYYY-MM-DD): only homes available by then.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Comma-separated amenities, all required: has_air_conditioning, has_balcony, has_bathtub, has_bbq, has_business_center, has_carport, has_carpet, has_ceiling_fan, has_dishwasher, has_doorman, has_elevator, has_fireplace, has_furnished_option, has_garage, has_garbage_disposal, has_granite_counter, has_gym, has_hardwood_floors, has_heat, has_hot_tub, has_ice_maker, has_in_unit_laundry, has_laundry_connections, has_on_site_laundry, has_parking, has_pickleball, has_pool, has_stainless_steel, has_walk_in_closet, is_accessible, is_cat_friendly, is_dog_friendly, is_pet_friendly, is_airbnb_friendly.

parameters.name: occupancy_types
parameters.description: Comma-separated housing programs: affordable, senior, student, military, co-living.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order: newest (the site's default), best_match, price_asc, price_desc.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Listings per page (1-16, default 8).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The places Apartment List knows for what was typed (cities, neighborhoods, ZIP codes, counties, states), each with its id, link, type, names, population, coordinates and map bounds. Use the id or link as the location of the search and rent-stats routes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/apartmentlist-suggest

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place name, ZIP code or part of one.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated place types to include: city, neighborhood, meta_neighborhood, zip, county, state (default all).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
